svg.title: Prepare TEM grid
svg.desc: Conceptual operation diagram; only source-stated equipment and conditions apply.
svg.text: Dropcast 5 µL dilute QD/toluene solution on the specified
carbon/copper grid. Dry for 10 min, then under vacuum overnight.
Exact dilution and drying temperature are unreported.
Conceptual operation diagram; only source-stated equipment and conditions apply.
